results.content:
The Resin Recharge Rate is 1 Resin per 8 minutes, which yields a total of 7 resins an hour. This is a pretty lengthy time but not all activities consume Original Resin, and it also recovers while the game is closed. Make sure to always spend Original Resin in time to maximize its use!

In Version 4.7 Developers Discussion, the resin cap is increased from 160 to 200, which means the resin recharge rate now takes 26 hours for the entire resin counter to fully replenish! results.content:
The replenishing cap of 200 can be exceeded through manual refills.
       When replenishing over the 200 cap, players have a hard cap maximum of 2,000 Original Resin. 
           Replenishing is unavailable when the count is above 1,940 (as such would result in values of 2,001 and above after refill). [...] Original Resin passively regenerates at a rate of 1 unit every 8 minutes, if it is not fully capped (200 total): 
       As long as the Original Resin is regenerating, you will go through 180 resin per 24 hours, 1260 resin per week. Thus it is advised to spend Resin whenever possible to not stay at the cap, as not to waste "potential" Resin.
       Full replenishment (from 0 to 200) will take 26 hours and 40 minutes. [...] Players can manually instantly replenish 60 Original Resin at a time: 
       Image 21: Fragile ResinImage 22: Fragile ResinFragile Resin ×1 or Image 23: Transient ResinImage 24: Transient ResinTransient Resin ×1 can be used to restore 60 Original Resin.
       Alternatively, players can replenish 60 Original Resin by using an increasingly expensive amount of Primogems, instead (up to 6 times a day, see the chart below).
